fullCAR_sharedflow_boundary_interior.method_scope: Complete 16CAR, two cells, two labelled roles; fixed n2 per initial label; actual unequal native onsite/hopping values. Explicit constructed reference, not an eigenground, g256 or spectral substitution.

native_support_orientation_norms.analytic_all_even_N_ge8: For axis0 the two root raw sites meet two excluded NN starts and four length2 starts. On a transverse axis two raw sites times two NN starts give4; two raw sites times three length2 starts give6. N>=8 prevents modulo alias; length2 includes the middle blocked cell. Costs already include both orientations.

sourceformation.normalization: Raw x has norm²=N; s=x/sqrt(N) has norm1. Heat M0,M1,M2 divide raw contractions by exactN.
sourceformation.rawN_vs_normalized_s_semantic_note: Analytic helper calls sqrt(rawN) source_norm; it is not ||s||. Here rawN>1, so eta*(1+sqrt(rawN))>=2eta and valid but unnecessarily loose; not a general formula.
sourceformation.historical_operation_model_status: CONDITIONAL; byte binding does not attest historical intermediate FTZ/DAZ or rounding.

native_alltime_convolution.all_spin_pair_blocks: Native4x4 contraction sums all independent sigma,tau; block zero only when actual matrix says zero.
native_alltime_convolution.tail_policy: No charged upper cutoff. Floor b>0 controls integral tails and Hermite divided difference for every x>=b.
